_about: Closed vocabularies for the DQ Enablement Studio knowledge corpus. Every knowledge unit's frontmatter is validated against these lists by build/build.py. Adding a value here is a deliberate CoE decision - commit message should say why.

concept.label: Concepts
concept.blurb: What things are - the ideas and constructs of the methodology.

principle.label: Principles
principle.blurb: Why we work this way - doctrine, rationale, and decided positions (ADRs carry kind: decision).

standard.label: Standards
standard.blurb: Enforceable rules for artefacts - SQL shape, naming, comments, structure (reusable shapes carry kind: pattern).

procedure.label: Procedures
procedure.blurb: How to do it, step by step - SOPs and runbooks.

reference.label: Reference
reference.blurb: Dense lookup material - SAP facts, schemas, vocabularies, catalogues.

glossary.label: Glossary
glossary.blurb: The ubiquitous language - one term per unit, cross-linked everywhere.

qa.label: Q&A
qa.blurb: Real questions with built answers - grows from the consultant feedback loop.

kinds.decision: A decided position (ADR-style) - valid on principles.
kinds.pattern: A reusable solution shape - valid on standards.

domains.dq-fundamentals: What data quality is: dimensions, lifecycle, why it matters.
domains.rule-design: Designing DQ rules: anatomy, naming, derivation, patterns, scoring.
domains.sql-standards: The Syniti SQL dialect: views, sections, comments, technical fields.
domains.studio: The DQ Studio application: architecture, pages, workflow.
domains.sap: SAP knowledge: systems, modules, tables, fields, processes.
domains.value-outcomes: Business outcomes, value levers, key issues, valuation discipline.
domains.cleanse: Cleanse execution: actions, tasks, process areas, status models.
domains.ai-enhancement: AI derivation and enhancement: prompts, guardrails, harness.
domains.delivery: Engagement delivery: phases, method, resourcing, client-facing practice.
domains.platform: The Syniti platform beyond the Studio: SKP, DPaaS, deployment.

audiences.consultant: DQ consultants designing and executing rules.
audiences.developer: People building or extending the CoE applications.

link_relations.prereq: Target should be understood before this unit.
link_relations.parent: This unit is a child/detail of the target.
link_relations.implements: This unit implements or operationalises the target.

source_repos.coe: authored directly in this knowledge base
